items.name: nessa-base
items.title: Nessa UI base
items.description: The Nessa UI foundation: Radix primitives, semantic color tokens, font stacks, and radius.

items.name: utils
items.title: Nessa utilities
items.description: Shared class-name composition utilities for Nessa UI.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An accessible action primitive with Nessa variants and sizes.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact label for statuses and metadata.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A composable surface for grouped content and actions.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A native checkbox styled in place, with a drawn check, a mixed (indeterminate) state for select-all controls, and native form participation.

items.name: task-list
items.title: Task list
items.description: A task list for agent plan steps and personal checklists: status-carrying rows (todo, active, done, failed) with circular indicators, trailing meta detail, host icons on agenda rows, and an interactive mode that turns todo/done rows into real circular checkboxes.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A themed text-entry primitive with invalid and disabled states.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A syntax-highlighted code block backed by Pierre's Shiki-based rendering, with a provider for app-wide code theming.

items.name: math-block
items.title: Math Block
items.description: KaTeX-rendered TeX formulas that stay steady while streaming, with markdown-format copy for display math.

items.name: generating-surface
items.title: Generating Surface
items.description: An ambient placeholder for content that takes a while to generate — drifting smoke and a shimmering status label reserve the space, then morph into the finished content when generation completes.

items.name: transcript-divider
items.title: Transcript Divider
items.description: A hairline rule with a label, marking a point in a transcript such as a context compaction.

items.name: gradient-surface
items.title: Gradient Surface
items.description: A decorative gradient backdrop for heroes and banners — a deep colour wash from a swappable palette, an optional contour, wave, or ring line overlay, and film grain over the whole frame.

items.name: mermaid-diagram
items.title: Mermaid Diagram
items.description: Mermaid diagrams — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and every other Mermaid grammar — rendered to SVG with app-wide light and dark theming and a fullscreen pan-and-zoom viewer.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A composable chat message row with optional avatar, bubble variants, streaming text, attachments, threading, hover-revealed action icons, and header and footer meta slots.

items.name: message-markdown
items.title: Message Markdown
items.description: Assistant markdown rendering for messages: GitHub-flavored markdown, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, and syntax-highlighted code styled with Nessa tokens.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A stick-to-bottom transcript scroller that follows streamed replies, releases on reader scroll, and restores the live edge with a floating control.

items.name: conversation-rail
items.title: Conversation Rail
items.description: An edge-mounted conversation navigator with proximity-magnified turn markers, hover or focus previews, and host-owned selection.

items.name: split-view
items.title: SplitView
items.description: Controlled resizable panel groups with accessible, keyboard-operable separators.

items.name: agent-stream
items.title: Agent stream parser
items.description: A framework-free parser for coding-agent output streams: decodes Claude Code's stream-json and Codex's exec --json into one harness-agnostic event log, and folds that log into the turns, tool groups, delegated runs and plan a transcript UI draws.

items.name: app-shell-layout
items.title: AppShell layout model
items.description: The serializable, framework-free layout document and pure operations behind AppShell.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: An IDE-style application shell: resizable docks around a recursively splittable workspace.

items.name: selection-tooltip
items.title: Selection Tooltip
items.description: A floating selection-callout pill of actions with a chevron-revealed, horizontally scrollable shelf.

items.name: searchable-listbox
items.title: Searchable Listbox
items.description: A reusable searchable single-select list with accessible roving focus.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: A provider-aware searchable chooser dedicated to model selection.

items.name: model-capability-controls
items.title: Model Capability Controls
items.description: Fast-mode and thinking-level controls composed beside a selected model.

items.name: chat-bubbles
items.title: Chat Bubbles
items.description: iMessage-style transcript primitives: aligned message columns with spring-in bubbles, reply quotes, delivery receipts, a pulsing typing indicator, the tapback reaction row with per-emoji cascade, and square attachment tiles with a fanned stack and a full-surface grid viewer.

items.name: chat-tabs
items.title: Chat Tabs
items.description: The floating chat window's tab strip: pill tabs on a scrolling tablist with chat-accent-tinted active state, busy dots, attention badges, per-tab close controls, a new-tab button, and roving arrow-key navigation.

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat Composer
items.description: A compound chat-entry surface with input, footer, action, and submit primitives, plus attachment pills, paste-to-attachment capture, an opt-in fileDrop capability that attaches files dropped anywhere over the composer, and key-triggered menus anchored above the composer.

items.name: pill-composer
items.title: Pill Composer
items.description: A compact pill-shaped chat composer that hosts the ChatComposer input, attachment, action, and trigger primitives in a single row, with an iridescent traveling-light rim that fades in while the agent works.

items.name: chat-composer-editor
items.title: Chat Composer Editor
items.description: A rich chat-composer input where attachments are atomic inline chips flowing with the text, with press and hover actions, plain-text paste and drop, and trigger-menu integration.

items.name: composer-queue
items.title: Composer Queue
items.description: Pending-message rows and queue-or-steer delivery controls for active agent runs.

items.name: composer-access-mode
items.title: Composer Access Mode
items.description: A compact access and approval mode dropdown using distinct shield states.

items.name: file-diff-list
items.title: File Diff List
items.description: Collapsible changed-file summary card with per-file diff stats, hover-revealed row actions, and a scrollable list region.

items.name: file-drop-zone
items.title: File Drop Zone
items.description: A wrapper that gives any children file drag-and-drop: nested-child drag tracking, accept, size and count rules, recursive folder expansion, and refusals reported with their reason — handing the host a filtered File list to store and render as attachments however it likes. It draws nothing and owns no controls, and asChild merges the whole protocol onto the child element.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool Call
items.description: An expandable tool-invocation row for agent transcripts: shimmering running label with icon, tabbed input and output, syntax-highlighted edit diffs, and clickable file chips.

items.name: json-tree
items.title: JSON Tree
items.description: A structured JSON renderer: muted keys, emphasized values, real JSON punctuation, and optional fold toggles on every object and array. Unopinionated monospace surface with data-slot hooks so hosts can restyle it per surface.

items.name: tool-approval
items.title: Tool Approval
items.description: A tool-permission request card: header with icon, title, and description, an optional monospace command payload, and a decision row of Button-based actions with key-cap shortcut hints. One request renders docked above the composer, as a compact floating panel, or dropping from the display notch via the variant prop.

items.name: reference
items.title: Reference
items.description: An inline citation chip for agent and research surfaces: hover or focus reveals a floating source card with excerpt, locator, pager, and link; clicking follows the source.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A composable question-flow kit: header with step counter or progress bar, fieldset questions with title and description, single or multiple selection over native inputs with custom check indicators, a freeform text answer, and an actions row with submit.

items.name: popover-surface
items.title: Popover surface
items.description: The floating overlay surface underneath Nessa's popover-style chrome: popover tokens over a hairline border, with elevation and radius variants and asChild projection.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: A right-click menu on Nessa's popover surface: items with icons and keyboard shortcuts, groups and labels, nested submenus, checkbox and radio selection, and a destructive item variant, built on Radix context-menu primitives.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: An accessible tab list and its panels: roving focus with arrow, Home and End keys, horizontal or vertical orientation, automatic or manual activation, and underline or pill presentation.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: A compact single-choice switcher: a bordered pill of pressed/unpressed buttons for view and scale toggles, with controlled or uncontrolled value state.

items.name: timeline-header
items.title: Timeline header
items.description: The band a horizontal scale lives on: pixel-offset cells with hairline dividers, and labels that pin at a chosen inset while any part of their cell is in view — the GanttChart's two-tier time header, extracted for any horizontally scrolled surface.

items.name: gantt-chart
items.title: Gantt chart
items.description: A project-plan timeline: a pinned task list with host-defined columns beside a scrollable day/week/month timeline of bars, milestones and roll-up summary brackets, with typed dependency arrows (finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish, start-to-finish) carrying lag, critical-path highlighting, drag-to-link, quick-create on empty lanes, a today marker, weekend shading, collapsible groups, and rescheduling by drag, edge-drag resizing or keyboard chords behind a confirmable move gate with an optional dependent cascade.

items.name: event-calendar
items.title: Event calendar
items.description: An Outlook-style scheduling surface with day, week, and month views: a toolbar with Today, paging, and a view switcher, a scrollable time grid with cascade-stacked event chips, an all-day shelf, a now indicator, drag or keyboard range selection with a slot for the host's own quick-create UI, and event rescheduling by drag, edge-drag resizing, or keyboard chords behind a confirmable move gate.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A composable application sidebar with controlled collapse state and keyboard support.

items.name: workflow-canvas
items.title: WorkflowCanvas
items.description: An infinite (or bounded) pan-and-zoom workflow canvas with draggable nodes that render any content, side handles for drawing connections, and edges that follow their endpoint nodes — built to stay responsive with thousands of nodes.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: A composable kanban board: columns of draggable cards with pointer and keyboard movement, a drop indicator marking the insertion point, settled moves reported through onCardMove, and screen-reader announcements for every step.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A composable action menu on the popover surface: trigger, content, groups with labels, plain, checkbox, and radio items with leading indicators, separators, shortcut hints, and nested submenus.

items.name: page-outline
items.title: Page outline
items.description: A scroll-spy section outline drawn along a rail that jogs to trace the heading hierarchy, with a comet pulse — or a host-supplied marker — that travels the rail to the section being read. Sections come from props or are derived from the headings of rendered content such as a markdown surface, and an auto-collapse mode folds deep branches away except where the reader has settled.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Composable pagination controls: a nav landmark, an item list, compact page buttons with an active accent treatment, previous/next controls, and a collapsed-run ellipsis.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A composable data-table kit: flat-panel table primitives with a click-to-toggle sortable header button, a filter toolbar with search, faceted selects, a disclosed advanced-filter panel and a column-visibility menu, and a windowed pagination bar.

items.name: flow-chart
items.title: Flow chart
items.description: A flow (Sankey) diagram: node bars in columns joined by ribbons whose thickness is proportional to the flow they carry. Bars take soft tints from a built-in palette (overridable per node or disableable to a neutral wash); ribbons color by source, target, or a source-to-target gradient. Four alignments (justify, left, right, center), optional d3-style barycenter iterations that reorder columns to untangle crossings, and horizontal or vertical orientation. It fills the host's box on both axes, lays out any number of stages via longest-path columns, tolerates and reports partial mid-stream data, floats host-supplied hover detail beside the pointer, and makes every ribbon a keyboard-focusable button with hover isolation and multi-selectable links.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: A radar (spider) chart: values plotted along spokes radiating from one centre, one closed outline per series. Series take soft tints from a built-in palette (overridable per series, or disableable to a neutral wash) and the area wash derives from each outline's own colour. Polygon, circular, or no grid; a curve control that relaxes the polygon into a closed spline; and a scale switch between one shared maximum and per-axis normalisation, with an explicit per-axis maximum overriding both. It fills the host's box on both axes, tolerates and reports partial mid-stream data, floats host-supplied hover detail beside the pointer, makes every outline a keyboard-focusable button with hover isolation and multi-selectable series, and adds an axis probe that marks and ranks every series' reading on one spoke.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie chart
items.description: A pie or donut chart: one wedge per slice, sized to its share of the total. Slices take soft tints from a built-in palette (overridable per slice, or disableable to a neutral wash), labels sit outside on leader lines, inside the wedge, or nowhere, and a donut's centre reads the total at rest and the engaged slice while one is hovered, focused, or solely selected. A long tail can be rolled into one bucket that keeps its members reachable, the sweep can be narrowed into a gauge, and slices sort by input order or value. It fills the host's box on both axes, tolerates and reports partial mid-stream data, floats host-supplied hover detail beside the pointer, and makes every wedge a keyboard-focusable button with hover isolation and multi-selectable slices that ease out of the ring.

items.name: random-avatar
items.title: Random avatar
items.description: A deterministic generative avatar painted rather than drawn: translucent pools of pigment on tinted paper, bled and granulated by turbulence. Several seeds paint one group picture, an ink ground carries it onto dark surfaces, and it can bloom on mount or keep flooding while an agent works.

items.name: file-preview
items.title: File preview
items.description: A composable file previewer that delegates each file type to a renderer registry: images, PDFs via the browser's built-in viewer, video and audio via native elements, Markdown through MessageMarkdown, JSON through JsonTree, CSV/TSV through the Table kit, text and code through CodeBlock, and unknown kinds through a fallback surface. Office formats are detected but detection-only; consumers extend or override renderers per kind without library changes.

items.name: price-chart
items.title: Price chart
items.description: A brokerage-style price plot: one hairline stroke in the market's colour with an optional tone wash, a dotted reference rule, a price scale over faint gridlines and a time scale that re-label themselves when a drag zooms into a window, a candle view over the same geometry, a pulsing marker for a streaming quote, and a cursor that scrubs by pointer, finger, or arrow key.

items.name: stock-quote
items.title: Stock quote
items.description: A brokerage-style quote panel: ticker, name and trading status, the price in large type with its change in the market's colour, a scrubbable and zoomable price chart with line and candle views, range controls that switch windows on their own, an after-hours line, and a strip of key figures — built for agents streaming live market data into a card or a full-width page.
